body_text:
Sequential criterion. A function $f$ has limit $L$ at an
accumulation point $x_0$ of its domain if and only if
$f(x_n)\to L$ for every sequence $(x_n)$ in the domain with
$x_n\ne x_0$ and $x_n\to x_0$. This criterion is specific to
first-countable settings such as metric spaces.
